name: Massacre Girl
description: Massacre Girl is a Rakdos killer for hire, first seen leading the attack on Cecilee's settlement on Ravnica and later an assassin at Karlov Manor.

summary.text: Massacre Girl is a Rakdos killer for hire, first seen leading the attack on Cecilee's settlement on Ravnica and later an assassin at Karlov Manor.

bio.text: She and her men break into Cecilee's settlement, tear up the young guild tree, and cut Cecilee's throat after her followers lie dead.

timeline.summary: Before sunrise, an ogre breaks through the gate followed by Massacre Girl and her men, who are not Gruul.
timeline.quote: Just before sunrise, their gate flew off the hinges and splintered on the ground.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl strikes Cecilee and tears the young guild tree from the ground.
timeline.quote: The woman ripped the young guild tree out of the ground and hurled it across the courtyard

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl cuts off Cecilee's hair while Cecilee freezes.
timeline.quote: The woman took out her rusty blade and chopped the blonde hair from Cecilee's head.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Cecilee's followers lie dead, and Cecilee, mute again and cut off from the Worldsoul, has her throat cut.
timeline.quote: There was just the woman and her rusty blade cutting Cecilee's throat

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Kuma smells blood and carries Ruzi through the shattered gate into the settlement, surprising Massacre Girl and her men.
timeline.quote: The two surprised Massacre Girl and her men as they searched the bodies for anything valuable.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl refuses to say who hired her, taunts Ruzi, and leaves with her cultists, throwing confetti.
timeline.quote: Tossing it up into the air, she did a twisted bow and sashayed for the gate.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi resolves to break from Selesnya and make destroying Massacre Girl his purpose, knowing Trostani would not permit vengeance.
timeline.quote: If justice was to be done, Ruzi must break from Selesnya and find another way.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: A figure in red and black attacks Proft; Etrata knocks her away and recognizes Massacre Girl.
timeline.quote: Proft was on the ground, a figure dressed in red and black crouching over him, a knife in either hand.

timeline.quote: I was supposed to kill the man who caught you.

timeline.quote: I'm helping him find out who really killed Zegana.

timeline.quote: There's always next time.

timeline.quote: She killed ten of my guards before I stopped her.

timeline.quote: her presence proves the Cult of Rakdos is behind all this senseless slaughter.

timeline.quote: they were attacked by Massacre Girl , who had been hired by Judith to kill Proft

timeline.summary: At Karlov Manor Zegana is assassinated and Massacre Girl attempts Aurelia's life; Kaya, Kellan and Agrus Kos win time to investigate.
timeline.quote: an attempt was made on her own life by Massacre Girl

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "Crime wave". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Etrata and Proft find yellow-gray powder at the safehouse and are attacked by Massacre Girl, whom Etrata forces to stand down.
timeline.quote: they were attacked by Massacre Girl

citation.text: "Etrata", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Judith hires Massacre Girl to kill Alquist Proft as a message to the investigators.
timeline.quote: She hired the Rakdos assassin Massacre Girl to kill Alquist Proft

citation.text: "Judith", section "Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Vitu-Ghazi, Oba is revealed as the organizer of the murders and attacks the guild leaders; Judith runs but is stopped by Massacre Girl.
timeline.quote: When Oba attacked the guild leaders, Judith ran away

citation.text: "Judith", section "Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl takes Judith and spends over a year torturing her in a hidden safehouse.
timeline.quote: spent more than a year torturing her in one of her hidden safehouses

citation.text: "Judith", section "Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kal wakes to learn Massacre Girl escaped and the bloodwitch was killed by his spell; he is rewarded with Durri's smile.
timeline.quote: Nikya told him that Massacre Girl had escaped

citation.text: "Kal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 10,075 ZC Massacre Girl is hired to destroy a Selesnyan vernadi in the Rubblebelt and kill its followers, including Cecilee.
timeline.quote: she was hired to destroy a Selesnyan vernadi in the Rubblebelt and kill its followers

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ruzi rallies the Zhur-Taa and burns the Azorius South Records Hall after stealing documents on Massacre Girl.
timeline.quote: Ruzi later broke into the Azorius South Records Hall and escaped with documents relating to Massacre Girl, before setting the building alight.

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gruul Zhur-Taa warriors attack Massacre Girl's Rakdos party; Kal's Izzet spell decimates her forces and she retreats from the Rubblebelt.
timeline.quote: Massacre Girl herself survived the battle and retreated from the Rubblebelt following this incident.

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hired by Judith, Massacre Girl attacks detective Alquist Proft but stops on learning he works with Etrata.
timeline.quote: She was surprised and managed to injure him, but stopped when she realized he was working with Etrata

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brainwashed by the true killer, Massacre Girl kills ten guards and attacks Aurelia, regaining consciousness after losing the fight.
timeline.quote: killing ten guards and only regaining consciousness after she lost a fight with the Boros guildmaster

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Released at Vitu-Ghazi where Oba is revealed as mastermind, she escapes with Judith, then attacks and takes Judith hostage on learning of her ploy.
timeline.quote: Massacre Girl attacked Judith with a knife and took her hostage.

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakdos' name is cleared and Judith is attacked by Massacre Girl.
timeline.quote: Judith was later attacked by Massacre Girl for trying to weaken the guild, leaving her whereabouts unknown.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Persecution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cult of Rakdos led by Massacre Girl slaughters Cecilee's followers and kills Cecilee; Zi survives and is rescued by Ruzi.
timeline.quote: Cecilee herself was killed, unaware that her adopted son Zi had survived
